# Niia Bieliavtseva

> Senior Product Designer, AI Design Engineer in New York, open to new roles (ideally AI-driven
> products). Designs interfaces and builds them into working products, prototyping in code with
> Claude. Led an AI coaching iOS app's redesign that lifted activation from 39% to 60% and
> week-one paid retention from 28% to 49%. Co-founder of Overspace, a product design studio.
